other_exits: Signal expiration: Long direction reset when OsMA crosses above MA (OsMA[0] >= MA[0] && OsMA[1] < MA[1]); Short direction reset when OsMA crosses below MA (OsMA[0] <= MA[0] && OsMA[1] > MA[1]). When direction resets to 0 and position still open, position is closed on next bar if signal does not match position type.

custom_logic_notes: Three EA variants exist in this codebase: (1) BandOsMACustomSignal.mq5 - multi-symbol support via TradingSignal interface with symbol/timeframe members, uses signal symbol for indicator calculation and iTime; (2) BandOsMACustom.mq5 - single-symbol with CustomOrder::setReplacementSymbol for symbol substitution, simpler TradingSignal interface without symbol/timeframe; (3) wstradecopier.mq5 - WebSocket-based trade copier with publisher/subscriber roles, JSON serialization of trade requests/results, symbol substitution on subscriber side, completely different trading logic (copies trades via WebSocket rather than generating own signals). The core BandOsMA logic is shared between variants 1 and 2. Signal direction is persistent state: once a buy/sell signal triggers, direction stays +1/-1 until OsMA crosses the MA line, creating a stateful signal system. The EA includes a sophisticated optimization framework using OnTesterInit/OnTesterDeinit with shadow parameters to avoid invalid fast>=slow period combinations. R-squared custom criterion is conditionally compiled via USE_R2_CRITERION macro. Entry signals use previous bar (index 1) and current bar (index 0) crossover detection to avoid repainting.
python_conversion_notes: Key challenges: (1) External .mqh libraries must be reimplemented - PositionFilter, DealFilter, MqlTradeSync, TradeState, AutoPtr, TrailingStop, SymbolMonitor all contain significant logic not visible in the EA file; (2) The AutoPtr template smart pointer pattern with [] operator dereferencing has no Python equivalent - convert to simple object references; (3) The signal direction state machine (direction persists until OsMA crosses MA) must be preserved exactly; (4) Bollinger Bands and MA are applied to the OsMA indicator handle output, not to price - this is an MQL5 feature where indicators can chain off other indicator handles, requiring manual implementation in Python (compute OsMA first, then compute BBands/MA on the OsMA series); (5) The optimization shadow parameter system (OnTesterInit with ParameterGetRange/ParameterSetRange) is MT5-specific and should be replaced with standard Python optimization frameworks; (6) The WebSocket trade copier variant requires a full WebSocket client implementation; (7) StopLoss of 1000 points with point_value dependency means SL distance = 1000 * point, no 5-digit adjustment needed as _Point already accounts for digit count; (8) TrailingStop distance = StopLoss (1000 points), step = StopLoss/50 (20 points); (9) Deviation (slippage) = StopLoss/50 = 20 points.
